knowledge.quote: Our furniture unites traditional craftsmanship, fine materials and a sustainable approach with a deep-rooted knowledge of how people want to live and work.

commitment.quote: Upholstery has a long tradition at Walter Knoll. Our company developed the first-ever modern upholstered furniture, and we remain masters of the art of upholstery to this day.

experimention.quote: Experimente mit neuen Materialien und die Entwicklung eines neuartigen Kunststoffs machten dies möglich.
